title: VAUGHN GITTIN JR. TELLS THE RTR STORY

headline: READY TO ROCK
THE STORY OF RTR
BY VAUGHN GITTIN JR.
data.body: Written with Mike Spinelli and published by Carrara Media: how RTR grew from a grassroots drift team in 2009 into a major name in the aftermarket and a Ford partner.

caption:
From a parking lot to a Ford partnership. Two-time Formula DRIFT champion @vaughngittinjr wrote the story of RTR together with Mike Spinelli: Ready To Rock, 256 pages with photography from top shooters. 📚
